main-page.about-me-p1: IT and software development have fascinated me for years. I currently work as a software developer with a focus on IT security, developing custom solutions tailored to each client's individual requirements – always with an eye on how software, infrastructure, and security come together.
main-page.about-me-p2: I also support information security officers (ISOs), coordinate documents and forms, and build internal tools that make it easier for teams to work together. I work in a structured, self-driven way and enjoy continuously growing my technical skills.
main-page.about-me-p3: Alongside my job, I build my own projects – from web applications and bots to setting up and running self-hosted server infrastructure. In my home lab I plan, operate, and automate server services, including my own VPN setups, Docker deployments, and game servers, deepening what I learn in practice.
